notes: Cash-basis village. Governmental lines from Statement of Receipts, Disbursements and Changes in Fund Balances (p4, Total Governmental Funds); business-type from proprietary statement (p6-7), which ties to the Statement of Activities (p1-2). Interfund transfers (General (11,835) / Street 11,835) net to zero in the total column, so top-level transfers are null; they appear in detail. Cash and fund balance kept separate: only fund balances printed as a roll-forward; cash/CD lines are on the balance sheet. Detail: General Fund from the departmental combining schedule (p11; more detailed than the p8-9 budget schedule, which is not recorded); Street Fund budget schedule (p10); utility combining schedule per fund (p12). The 'Other' department of the General Fund mixes public safety, culture/recreation and economic development (derived from p4 function totals). Read pages 1-12 of 12
